subject.title: feat(android): platform trust for public gateway certs + manual fingerprint pinning

question: Should Android permit platform CA and HTTPS-hostname verification to replace mandatory TOFU pinning for eligible public DNS Gateway endpoints while retaining existing pins until the user explicitly switches?
rationale: This is a durable product security-policy choice, not a mechanical test or parser decision: it determines when a Gateway identity can rely on the Android system trust store instead of a persisted user pin.

options.title: Approve the bounded system-trust model
options.body: Allow the public-host path only after the parser defect is repaired and device proof confirms hostname-verified platform trust, preserved pins, and manual recovery.

options.title: Keep TOFU pinning mandatory
options.body: Reject system-trust fallback and retain the existing pin-first model for every Gateway endpoint.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded system-trust model
recommendation.body: Allow the public-host path only after the parser defect is repaired and device proof confirms hostname-verified platform trust, preserved pins, and manual recovery.
